links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of DL combined with human reader versus double reading

links.outcome: Stand-alone DL algorithm sensitivity and specificity versus single human first reader
links.effect: Two of three algorithms had noninferior sensitivity (DL-1 64.8%, DL-2 56.7%, DL-3 58.9% vs 62.8%); specificity noninferior for DL-1 (92.8%) and DL-2 (96.8%), superior for DL-3 (97.9%) vs 96.5%.
links.quote: Two of three stand-alone DL algorithms achieved noninferior sensitivity (DL-1: 64.8%, P < .001; DL-2: 56.7%, P = .03; DL-3: 58.9%, P < .001) compared with the single first reader (62.8%), and specificity was noninferior for DL-1 (92.8%; P < .001) and DL-2 (96.8%; P < .001) and superior for DL-3 (97.9%; P < .001) compared with the single first reader (96.5%).

links.outcome: External validation of commercial DL algorithms on independent UK screening dataset
links.effect: Three commercial algorithms externally validated on 26,722 consecutive cases from two UK sites with two vendors' machines; two of three stand-alone were noninferior in sensitivity to a single reader.
